capability_type.persisted_features: one float32 SAM-derived scalar per native LUDVIG Gaussian per seed
capability_type.selector: the scalar primitive uplift rendered to the target and thresholded with the frozen NVOS parameter 75

information_boundary.per_camera_operation: read that registered camera RGB, render inverse-scribble 3D support into the camera as positive point prompts, run SAM on that RGB, then uplift the returned scalar mask

mapping_conclusion.claim_boundary: the transferred value remains a query-specific, target-RGB-informed compatible sidecar and cannot become a strict or query-free canonical capability
mapping_conclusion.minimum_faithful_reuse: retain each cached native LUDVIG Gaussian geometry and its scalar features; render those scalar fields through registered cameras and apply an exact image-space adjoint onto canonical primitives
mapping_conclusion.minimum_reuse_cost: eight scene bridges per seed, consisting only of scalar rendering plus canonical adjoint; no repeated SAM call is needed when cached scalar features are accepted
mapping_conclusion.query_free_DINO_relation_reconstruction: requires a new DINOv2/PCA40 all-view extraction and uplift because no such asset exists in this reproduced SAM run
mapping_conclusion.reason: all eight native all-view Gaussian row counts differ from the strict canonical geometry; nearest-neighbor transfer is strongly many-to-one and usually many canonical spacings away
